title: Investigate API 33 release walkthrough ANR
lead: Investigate the observed API 33 release ANR and establish whether it is an app failure or a test-environment failure. Do not infer a root cause from one run.
findings_note: S22 API 33 signed release showed Consecutor is not responding during notification permission walkthrough; ActivityManager recorded input dispatch timeout at 2026-10-05 07:37:34. Root cause unverified; four emulators and concurrent uiautomator commands were active.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** speculative fixes, release tagging, or assuming the ANR is an app defect without reproduction and runtime evidence.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S22 displayed “Consecutor isn’t responding” during notification permission testing. ActivityManager reported an input dispatch timeout for MainActivity at 2026-10-05 07:37:34 with PID 9948. Four emulators and concurrent uiautomator commands were active. The cause is unverified.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: S22 build/s22-validation/emulator-5560/permission-stopped.png and XML; emulator logcat and a fresh signed-release walkthrough. Application source only if the investigation identifies a defect.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: Observed Android ANR dialog and ActivityManager input timeout, not a failing assertion in the 56 passing API 33 instrumentation tests.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Reproduce the permission walkthrough on API 33 with one emulator and sequential input.
2. Capture the ANR report and app/runtime evidence if it recurs. Distinguish driver and emulator delays from an application defect.
3. Fix only an evidenced application defect; otherwise document the environment cause and a reliable release rerun.
4. Repeat allow, deny twice, settings, and normal dashboard navigation on the signed release.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: The signed API 33 release completes the permission walkthrough without ANR. Record reproducibility, evidence, and cause or remaining uncertainty; passing debug tests alone do not close this observation.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when asked; use the project slice worktree workflow.
